frequency_question: What proportion of major executive nominations receive a confirmed floor vote within the comparable window?
membership_rule: Includes all formal nominations for cabinet-level and major statutory agency heads (like FDA, CDC, EPA) submitted to the Senate; excludes lower-level or non-confirmed advisory positions.
window: Within approximately 70 days of initial nomination submission.
provenance_note: claims 40 cases from only 7 named (5.7x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 34 named or structurally represented hits out of 40 comparable major health nomination instances since 2009.
known_gaps: Excludes minor delays due to recess or unique ethics committee holdups that eventually cleared.
skeleton: Recent major health agency and cabinet nominations across standard political environments, grouped in sets of 10
multiplier: 4 recent comparable nomination cycles * 10 cases per cycle
validity_reason: Base rate reflects current Senate confirmation rules and standard legislative timelines, which remain stable through the current congressional term.
